The '''Mud-Jumpers''' were a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] unit under the [[224th]].

==History==
They [[Battle of Mimban/Legends|fought]] on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and received a shout-out on a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] musical broadcast.
